cause_quote: The new startup path passed `signal: options.signal` into snapshot preparation, which allocated an owned staging root and made removal failure throw via `else if (ownedRoot) { throw new Error(...) }`.
user_saw: On native Windows with stock Bun, the Gateway stopped at schema preflight with an EBUSY cleanup error, and `gateway status --deep` failed with a snapshot lease cleanup error.
summary: The fix defers EBUSY snapshot cleanup after successful reads on runtimes without reliable native SQLite close and makes deep status preserve the underlying removal error.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #138986 and confirmed that Gateway schema preflight already read private snapshots and ignored the cleanup return value, so a busy removal could leave the directory pending without aborting preflight. #138986 made that same startup cleanup fatal by passing a signal, while #156265 later made a false cleanup result fatal as well. The history establishes the change in error handling, but I could not verify a successful Windows Bun startup on the earlier revision.
